name: Log10x
tagline: Rank log patterns by volume and cost
description: Ranks log patterns by volume and cost and plans compact (Splunk, self-managed Elasticsearch), tier down or offload to S3 for the excess over each cap. Runs locally over stdio; no log data reaches log10x. Without an API key it runs read-only against a public demo dataset.

env.name: LOG10X_API_KEY
env.description: Log10x API key. Without it the server runs read-only against the public demo dataset.
